added.title: Senior Vice President, Product Enablement — Product Practice
added.description:
Job Description

Senior Vice President, Product Enablement — Product Practice

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Enablement to join our Product Practice team. This role is located in New York, NY.

Role Purpose

The Product Practice ensures BNY has world-class capabilities powering industry-leading products enabling us to deliver solutions at scale for our clients. The Product Practice sets standards and serves as enabler across the product lifecycle.

The Senior Vice President of Product Enablement for the Product Practice is responsible for building and supporting the operating environment, capabilities, and governance that enables product teams to deliver consistent, measurable, and scalable outcomes. This role drives the standards, tooling, data products, and operating cadences required to strengthen product management effectiveness, improve decision quality through reliable product data and metrics, and accelerate adoption of AI-enabled ways of working.

The Senior Vice President partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Operations, and business stakeholders to improve how products are planned, instrumented, measured, governed, and continuously enhanced.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Establish and evolve product management frameworks, including lifecycle practices, business case expectations, and outcome measurement standards.
Build and oversee a product data and metrics capability that enables consistent KPI/OKR definition, metric governance (definitions, owners, calculation logic), semantic layers, dashboarding, reporting automation, and actionable performance insights across the product portfolio.
Build and mature product analytics tooling (dashboards, self-service reporting, metric semantic layers, and standardized data products) in partnership with Data/Engineering; define requirements, ensure usability, and drive adoption across product teams.
Support AI enablement for Product by identifying practical use cases, supporting responsible adoption, and embedding AI tools and workflows that improve product strategy, discovery and planning, execution and delivery, product commercialization, and efficiency of product management and governance.
Drive portfolio-level visibility into product health, value realization, delivery progress, adoption trends, client outcomes, and operational risks.
Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Advanced degree in business, technology, data, or a related field.
10-12 years of experience
Experience in product management, product operations, product enablement, strategy, or a related leadership discipline within a complex, regulated organization.
Strong knowledge of product lifecycle management, portfolio governance, KPI design, performance reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
Demonstrated experience defining and operationalizing product taxonomies and mappings (e.g., product hierarchy, journey-to-product relationships, capability mapping), including ID strategy and governance to support rollups, reporting, and metric attribution.
Experience architecting data structures and infrastructure to enable seamless access and linkage of product context and capabilities across teams.
Demonstrated technical fluency in product analytics and reporting (e.g., SQL, KPI/metric design, dashboard development, data modeling/semantic layers, and instrumentation concepts) sufficient to partner effectively with data and engineering teams.
Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled tools and practical applications that support product management, workflow efficiency, insight generation, or decision support.
Knowledge of governance considerations related to AI, model risk, data privacy, and responsible technology use.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Technology, Data, and business stakeholders.
Proven leadership capability, including organizational influence, talent development, and delivery through direct and matrixed teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at executive level.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:

BNY Newsroom

BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

BNY assesses market data to ensure a competitive compensation package for our employees. The base salary for this position is expected to be between $104,000 and $200,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base salary if hired will be determined on an individualized basis, including as to experience and market location, and is only part of the BNY total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, discretionary bonuses, short and long-term incentive packages, and Company-sponsored benefit programs.

This position is at-will and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, change in geographic location, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

added.title: Sr. Director, Product Management, UHNW Platform
added.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Sr. Director, Product Management, UHNW Platform to lead the strategy and evolution of the platform supporting Mercer Advisor’s Regis Group—our integrated offering designed to serve ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients with complex, family office–level needs.

This role has end-to-end responsibility for the product strategy, client and advisor experience, and technology roadmap for the Regis platform. You will define how the platform—spanning people, process, and technology—should evolve to support a highly differentiated client segment, translating complex business needs into clear product direction, well-architected workflows, and actionable requirements.

Operating at the intersection of business, operations, and technology, you will own what we build and why, working in close partnership with external partners and the technology team, responsible for how solutions are built, and with the advisory teams who use those solutions and are responsible for delivering successful client outcomes. While highly strategic in scope, this role is also hands-on, requiring direct engagement in discovery, workflow design, and product definition.

A critical aspect of this role is developing a deep understanding of how advisors, investment professionals, tax specialists, estate planning strategists, and operational teams work in practice. You will engage directly with stakeholders across the organization—observing workflows, identifying friction points, and synthesizing often inconsistent inputs into clear problem definitions and scalable platform solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in complexity, brings structure to ambiguity, and balances strategic vision with disciplined execution and follow-through to measurable business results.

Essential Job Functions For This Role Include

Product strategy, discovery, and client experience ownership

Define and own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for the Regis platform to balance near-term priorities with long-term transformational goals
Translate business strategy, client needs, and advisor feedback into a cohesive, prioritized product direction
Develop a deep, first-hand understanding of workflows across advisors, clients, and operational teams through direct engagement
Synthesize diverse and sometimes conflicting inputs into clear problem statements and high-impact opportunities
Identify root causes of friction and design scalable, integrated workflows that improve client and advisor experience
Bring structure to an evolving environment, shifting from reactive development to intentional product design

Product definition and solution design

Translate Regis Ultra High Net Worth and Family Office business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and process flows
Lead product discovery and solution design to ensure the right problems are being solved
Partner with engineering and architecture teams to design solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned to long-term platform goals
Ensure consistency and integration across a multi-system platform ecosystem
Own Regis platform adoption to drive utilization of new process flows, measure advisor and client engagement with platform capabilities, and provide hands-on enablement support to ensure use as designed

Roadmap management and delivery execution

Define and manage a prioritized product roadmap, balancing business impact, user needs, technical constraints, and dependencies
Align roadmap decisions with strategic objectives while operating within budget and resource constraints
Partner with internal technology team and external partners to translate priorities into execution plans
Remain actively engaged through delivery to ensure outcomes align with product intent and business objectives

Cross-functional leadership and platform stewardship

Serve as the central point of alignment across Product, Technology, Operations, Investments, Compliance, and external partners
Facilitate decision-making across competing priorities, trade-offs, and sequencing considerations
Influence stakeholders at all levels without direct authority and lead cross-functional initiatives
Oversee the evolution of a multi-system platform ecosystem, ensuring it remains integrated, scalable, and aligned to long-term needs

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

10+ years of experience in product management, platform strategy, or related roles
Experience with UHNW or family office environments
Proven experience leading complex, multi-system platform initiatives in cross-functional environments
Demonstrated ability to operate across both strategic planning and hands-on execution
Strong experience in product discovery, workflow design, and requirements definition
Track record of translating complex business needs into well-designed product solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with comfort operating in ambiguous environments
Bachelor’s degree required

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in wealth management, financial services, or investment platforms
Experience with CRM systems, portfolio management tools, and client reporting platforms
Background in operating model design, process transformation, or platform modernization
Awareness of industry trends and emerging practices in wealth management technology

What Success Looks Like

A clearly defined and aligned product roadmap supporting the growth of the Regis platform
Measurable improvements in client and advisor experience and adoption of both new and existing capabilities
A cohesive, scalable platform that reduces friction and improves operational efficiency
Strong cross-functional alignment and effective prioritization
Delivery of solutions that are well-designed, integrated, and aligned with long-term strategy

Work Schedule

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

All roles classified as a non-exempt are required to record working time into the timekeeping system daily at the start and end of each workday plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch period.

Working Conditions

This position may be in a professional office environment or a dedicated home office workspace which is free of interruptions. Whether position is in a dedicated office space or home office workspace, basic technology needs will be provided to satisfy position requirements. Routinely sitting and standing for periods of time. No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

Application Deadline
: The initial deadline for applications is 8/15/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications. This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range

$190,000 - $210,000 USD

Benefits

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees. Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance
Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Supplemental Life & AD&D; Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.
Kaiser Medical plans available in California
Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.
Two comprehensive Dental Plans
Vision Insurance Plan
Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.
14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.
Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days
Employee Assistance Plan
Family Medical Leave
Paid Parental Leave (8 weeks)
Maternity benefits utilizing company paid STD, any supplemental STD, plus Parental Leave (8 weeks) to provide time for recovery, baby bonding, and enjoying your family time.
Adoption Assistance Reimbursement Program
Company Paid Concierge Services for you and your loved ones for the spectrum of caring needs for your aging parents, young children, life’s challenges and more.
401(k) Retirement Plan with both Traditional and Roth plans with per pay period match as well as an after-tax option
Pet Insurance
Personalized financial planning and guidance from Mercer Advisors professionals, offered at preferred employee pricing

added.title: Senior Product Manager (Creatives)
added.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.
The Creatives team is on a mission to build a one-stop-shop for advertisers' creative production and management needs. We're developing a comprehensive in-house product that lets clients create, enhance, preview, store, and manage CTV, video, audio, DOOH, display, and native ads at scale — whether they start from ready-made templates or build from scratch. By delivering a robust, full-featured in-house solution, we reduce our clients' reliance on costly third-party creative providers and empower advertisers to move faster and more efficiently.
The next chapter for the team centers on AI-powered content generation and a multi-channel creative experience, with particular focus on AI first video and CTV solutions. It's a high-impact, fast-moving area with significant room to define the product, the technology, and the creative workflows that will set the standard for how advertisers build at scale.
As a Senior Product Manager on the Creatives team, you'll own a portfolio at the heart of this ambition. This is a 0→1 space that spans multiple teams and disciplines, and you'll set the direction for it: shaping strategy, making the hard calls, and shipping. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue to translate a bold vision into products advertisers love.
StackAdapt is a remote first company. This role is open to candidates in Canada and the United States. 
What You'll Be Doing
Own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for a portfolio spanning the video/CTV creative builder, AI-generated and brand content products, and creative integrations with social and partner platforms.
Lead 0→1 initiatives from first principles — research and validate the problem, frame the opportunity, define the path forward, and drive it to launch and adoption.
Translate complex, cross-team problems into a clear vision and crisp, actionable requirements that give Engineering, Design, and QE unambiguous direction on how features should behave.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to shape how AI/ML and generative content capabilities are applied across creative formats, making sound technical trade-offs along the way.
Define key success metrics, monitor KPIs, and make data-informed decisions about what to build, what to cut, and what to double down on.
Work hand-in-hand with Creative Studio to ensure the tooling reflects real creative workflows and produces work that meets a high creative and brand bar.
Build new integrations with external platforms, partnering across teams to open up a wider range of creative assets and ad formats within the creative library.
Communicate precisely and proactively across the organization, keeping stakeholders aligned and informed at the right level and the right time.
Support customer-facing teams by resolving questions about your portfolio and helping triage bugs and regressions as they appear.

What You'll Bring to the Table
Proven experience as a Product Manager at a technology company, with a track record of shipping large, complex software products end-to-end (and you can speak to your successes).
Demonstrated success leading 0→1 initiatives that span multiple teams — you bring structure and direction to new problem spaces and rally others around a clear plan.
Experience building products in AdTech, MarTech, or creative platforms, with a meaningful edge for those who've worked on creative-building or generative AI products.
Strong fluency with AI/ML and generative AI concepts — enough to partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering, reason about capabilities and limitations, and make informed product decisions.
A technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience) that lets you discuss technical trade-offs, integrations, and architecture credibly with engineers.
A keen design and creative sense, balanced with technical depth — you pair an eye for what "great" looks like with the ability to partner closely with engineering on how to build it.
An excellent cross-functional collaborator who can tailor your approach across Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue without skipping a beat.
Clear, structured writing and communication — you distill complex ideas into words that build consensus and align stakeholders around your vision.
Strong prioritization instincts grounded in reason, clarity, and purpose — you focus the team on the most impactful work and the KPIs you're moving.
A leadership style rooted in influence rather than formal authority, and the judgment to operate independently in a fast-moving, evolving space.

added.title: Group Product Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation
added.description:
About The Role

As the Group Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation, you will provide strategic and people leadership for H&R Block’s analytics and experimentation capabilities across a portfolio of products and experiences. You will set the vision, operating model, and standards for experimentation and analytics, ensuring data-driven decision-making, trusted insights, and scalable practices are embedded across product discovery, delivery, and optimization. By combining deep domain expertise with organizational leadership, you will lead high-performing teams and position analytics and experimentation as a key driver of product growth and competitive advantage.

Day to day, you'll...

Partner with product leaders to define strategy and vision for Product Analytics & Experimentation across H&R Block products & experiences, aligning to enterprise objectives and product strategy
Lead and develop a team by providing clear direction, coaching, and growth paths while setting a high bar for execution and impact
Establish and scale enterprise standards for experiment design, analytics tagging, validation, and data governance to ensure trusted, actionable insights
Manage and support the experimentation roadmap across product lines, ensuring prioritization balances learning velocity, customer impact, and business outcomes
Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Risk to integrate analytics and experimentation into roadmaps, discovery, and delivery workflows
Champion tooling and platform decisions, such as Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, AEP, and CJA, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and operational excellence
Create clarity and alignment through documentation, operating norms, and communication that enable teams to confidently design, execute, and interpret experiments
Present insights, recommendations, and risks to senior leadership, translating complex data into clear narratives that inform strategy and investment decisions
Model and reinforce a culture of learning, curiosity, and evidence-based decision-making across the product organization 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent through a combination of education and related work experience
7+ years of experience in product analytics, experimentation, product management, or related fields
Proven success leading teams, managers, and high-performing organizations
Expertise in digital analytics, experimentation, and data-driven product decision-making, including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, AEP, and Customer Journey Analytics
Experience building and scaling processes, standards, and operating models across multiple teams
Exceptional ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and influence executive stakeholders
Strategic and people-focused leader with strong technical acumen, a balance of long-term vision and execution, and a passion for developing talent and high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in highly regulated environments with close partnership across Risk and Compliance 
Familiarity with Agile, Lean, and product development best practices at scale 
Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, and Figma, or similar tools 
Certifications in Agile, Product Management, Experimentation, or Analytics 

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

Pay Range Information

The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit.

added.title: Business Unit Control - Senior Product Manager
added.description:
About Millennium

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

Meet the Team

Operations & Middle Office is one of the firm’s largest departments and plays a critical role across the post-trade lifecycle. Within this environment, the Business Unit Control team provides independent oversight, control, and analysis across key business activities. The Product Development team connects business needs with delivered technology through a disciplined operating model that includes closed-loop prioritization, structured testing with clear accountability, and a governance cadence designed to drive decisions, transparency, and measurable progress. The team supports strategic platforms across areas such as P & L, financing, NAV, returns, and valuation controls, partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders to help the platform scale in a controlled, sustainable way.

What You'll Do

Own product direction and long-term value for a portfolio of products or applications, translating demand from multiple business functions into a clear, cohesive roadmap
Lead product development efforts for core applications supporting the firm’s P & L, Street and PM financing, NAV, returns, and valuation controls across asset classes and product types traded globally
Partner closely with Senior Leadership, funding desks, Treasury, Middle Office, Operations, Finance, and Technology to align priorities and drive execution
Lead initiatives end to end, including new product implementations, enhancement of existing platforms, and definition of future-state product vision with appropriate controls embedded from the outset
Work with Business Analysts and Technology team leads to assess effort, define acceptance criteria, and provide final release approval based on compiled test evidence and business intent
Chair governance forums and prepare materials for program updates, bi-weekly prioritization reviews, and stakeholder discussions
Serve as the senior point of contact for the workstream, guiding stakeholder discussions toward decisions and translating delivery progress into clear updates for senior leadership
Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities, and turn them into practical, scalable solutions

What You Bring

8+ years of relevant experience in product management, business analysis, or a delivery-focused product function
Demonstrated people management experience, including leading, mentoring, and developing Product Managers or similar delivery professionals
Proven experience owning backlogs and prioritizing across multiple business functions, with a track record of turning competing demand into a coherent roadmap
Strong judgment in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, with the ability to drive accountability and execution across teams without direct authority
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate delivery detail into clear, effective messaging for senior audiences
Experience running governance forums and serving as a senior point of contact for leadership and key stakeholders
Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams, assess feasibility and cost, and support data-driven decision-making
Product or domain knowledge in P & L, financing, NAV, valuation, or other control systems within financial services is preferred; familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Agile delivery, UAT practices, and tools such as SQL, Python, Java, or AWS is advantageous

Salary Range

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $160,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

About the Role InCharge Energy is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Product Officer (CPO)
to lead our product vision, strategy, and execution. This executive leadership role will be responsible for shaping the long-term product roadmap, identifying new market opportunities, and ensuring that our products and solutions continue to meet the evolving needs of customers and the broader electric mobility ecosystem.
The ideal candidate brings 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, technology, or related leadership roles
, with a strong track record of building and scaling products in dynamic, technology-driven environments.
As CPO, you will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams across engineering, technology, operations, sales, marketing, and business development to translate market opportunities into scalable products and solutions.
Key Responsibilities Define and lead the company's overall product vision, strategy, and long-term roadmap.
Build and execute product strategies aligned with company growth objectives and customer needs.
Lead the full product lifecycle, from market research and concept development through launch, optimization, and scaling.
Identify emerging technologies, market trends, customer requirements, and new product opportunities.
Partner closely with engineering and technology teams to translate product strategy into clear development priorities.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, operations, and business development teams to support successful product launches and commercialization.
Establish product performance metrics and use data, customer insights, and market intelligence to guide decision-making.
Develop scalable product management processes, operating models, and governance frameworks.
Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing product organization.
Represent the product function within the executive leadership team and communicate product priorities, opportunities, and performance.
Maintain a strong understanding of the EV charging, energy, infrastructure, and technology landscape.

added.title: Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships
added.description:
Job Description

About Semarchy

Semarchy was founded in 2011 in Lyon, France, by a team of passionate data experts with a clear mission: modernizing master data management. Over the years, we’ve expanded our capabilities into Data Management, Integration, and Intelligence, building a unified design experience that accelerates revenue growth, modernizes workflows, and boosts enterprise AI initiatives.

Headquartered in Arizona, USA, with global offices across France, the UK, and India, Semarchy serves over 400 clients worldwide, including Fortune 500 leaders. Trusted by industry innovators, our adaptive, modular approach helps organizations achieve data-driven success in as fast as 12 weeks.

About The Role

Semarchy’s Snowflake Native App achieved proven product-market fit in Year One of the partnership, with multiple enterprise wins already on the books. Rapid growth in pipeline, awareness, and interest — combined with the joint Semarchy/Snowflake roadmap — is creating a major scaling opportunity for 2026 and beyond.

The Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships is a unique hybrid leadership role that sits at the intersection of product and partnerships. You will own two tightly connected missions: driving deep technical and product alignment with our strategic technology partners — initially with Snowflake and Microsoft — and driving product management for Semarchy’s Snowflake-native solutions so that our roadmap and our partners’ platforms advance together as one strategy.

This role is strictly focused on technical alignment with partners — product roadmaps, platform capabilities, integrations, and joint solution architecture — not on commercial or sales plays, which are owned by our alliance and sales teams. That said, you must bring strong commercial savvy: an understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales so that technical alignment translates into market impact.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Product Management (based in France) for your product management responsibilities. Snowflake is our most mature partnership and the immediate priority, with Microsoft — where our technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — as the second strategic focus. Beyond these, this role owns Semarchy’s broader technology partnership strategy and will explore potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role to start, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the partnership portfolio scales. It is built for someone with high agency: a builder who creates structure, drives follow-through, and earns the trust of partner product and engineering organizations.

Location:
USA, remote, in the Central or Eastern time zone. You will collaborate daily with our product and engineering teams in France and coordinate regularly with technology partners primarily based in the western USA, so working hours that bridge both are essential.

Job Requirements

Must Have

10+ years in enterprise software, including 5+ years in technical partnerships, partner engineering, solutions leadership, or product management roles within cloud ecosystems.
Proven success driving technical and product alignment with one or more of: Snowflake, Microsoft/Azure, or other major cloud data platforms.
Hands-on product management experience: gathering requirements, writing specifications, managing a backlog, and partnering with engineering to ship.
Deep working knowledge of the modern data stack (cloud data platforms, data management, integration, or analytics).
Commercial savvy: a strong understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales teams.
Comfortable operating across technology, product, and executive relationships, including with senior partner product and engineering leaders.
Strong program management skills and high agency — driven to get things done; elite communication and soft skills, including the ability to translate technical depth for commercial audiences.
Based in the US Central or Eastern time zone, with the flexibility to overlap with teams in France (mornings) and partners on the US West Coast (afternoons); willingness to travel (~25%) for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry events.

Nice to Have

Direct experience with Snowflake Native Apps, Snowpark, or building solutions on the Snowflake Marketplace.
Experience with the Microsoft Partner ecosystem and marketplaces.
Domain expertise in master data management (MDM), data integration, data products, semantic intelligence.
Experience working in a globally distributed organization across US and European time zones; French language skills are a plus.
Experience building and leading partner engineering or product teams.

Job Responsibilities

Technology Partnership Strategy & Technical Alignment (initially with Snowflake and Microsoft)

Define and own Semarchy’s technology partnership strategy, exploring and prioritizing potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.
Own the technical relationship with our strategic technology partners: lead roadmap discussions, technical alignment, and advanced configuration conversations with partner product and engineering counterparts.
Ensure Semarchy capitalizes early on new Snowflake platform capabilities, and that our Native App strategy stays ahead of the Snowflake roadmap.
Deepen technical alignment with Microsoft — where Semarchy’s technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — including integration architecture, platform certifications, and marketplace technical requirements.
Build relationships with partner engineering, partner technical, and ISV teams to establish Semarchy’s technical credibility on each platform.
Establish and maintain joint technical escalation paths with Support and Professional Services for pre/post-sales support and joint problem resolution.
Serve as the technical voice of the partnerships in reviews with Semarchy leadership.
Establish the repeatable playbook — technical evaluation, product integration, roadmap alignment — that future technology partnerships will follow.
As the portfolio scales, help define the team needed to support it, with the opportunity to hire and lead.

Product Management

Drive product management for Semarchy’s partner-aligned solutions — expanding our Snowflake-aligned capabilities and our alignment with Microsoft Fabric — working day-to-day with the Head of Product Management and engineering teams in France.
Gather and synthesize requirements from customers, partners, partner field teams, analysts, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized roadmap for the Snowflake Native App and related capabilities.
Produce specifications, refine and organize the product backlog, and partner with engineering to deliver high-value features and product iterations.
Champion the solutions internally and externally — with customers, partners, analysts, and field teams — and feed their input back into product strategy and positioning.

Cross-Functional & GTM Collaboration

Work closely with product marketing and marketing to ensure positioning, launch content, and partner-facing assets accurately reflect joint technical capabilities.
Support sales and alliance teams as the technical authority on partner platforms — helping them understand what is possible, what is roadmapped, and how joint solutions are architected.
Partner with enablement teams to develop technically accurate training, demos, and assets for internal teams and partner field organizations.
Ensure Snowflake, Microsoft, and Semarchy owners are connected across Product Management, Support, and Professional Services, and keep Product, GTM, and Operations working against one shared partner plan.

What Success Looks Like

Snowflake and Microsoft product and engineering teams know exactly who owns the technical relationship with Semarchy.
The Snowflake solutions roadmap is visibly shaped by partner and customer input, and product releases land in sync with partner platform milestones and joint GTM motions.
Sales, marketing, and alliance teams have a trusted technical authority on partner platforms — joint solutions are well-architected and well-understood.
Product, GTM, and Operations work against one shared partner plan.

Job Benefits

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy.

For those applicants in the CA, CO and NYC area, the salary range for this role is $225K to $250K base plus variable incentive. The salary offered will be based on experience, role, and location.
